fufu 0.19.1 is a patch release. [`ff done`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/done/) now says where resolution edits made outside the conflict markers landed.

## Edits outside the markers

In a resolution session the working copy is the whole rewrite's result, so an edit outside every marker block lands in the last replayed commit rather than the commit the markers name. When that is a different commit from the ones the conflicts came from, `ff done` names it and the files, and prints the [`ff absorb`](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/reference/cli/absorb/) line that moves each file's edits to the one earlier commit that owns them. JSON carries the report as `done.outside`. See [held rewrites](https://tyler-johnson.github.io/fufu/concepts/held-rewrites/#the-session).
